historical_references.reference: Mythily was a royal name in the Chola Empire of ancient India. It was borne by a queen consort by the name of Mythily Devi, who ruled alongside Rajaraja Chola I in the late 11th century.

In Hindu mythology, Mythily is an alternative name for the goddess Parvati, the consort of Lord Shiva. Myths describe her as the embodiment of love and compassion, who is believed to have the power to soothe and calm the deity.
